plan: SEARCH o USING PRIMARY KEY (state=? AND ns=? AND key=?)
query: SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(tokens),0) FROM incoming WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM predecessors AS p CROSS JOIN observed AS o WHERE o.state=p.state AND o.ns=? AND o.key=incoming.key)
storage_scope: 32-byte key and namespace per state; embedding vectors stored separately, excluded
